name: Statement Group 5
definition: Group of the statement header reporting the bank services billing and the billing statement.

GroupIdentification.name: Group Identification
GroupIdentification.definition: Identification of a group of customer billing statements.

Sender.name: Sender
Sender.definition: Originating financial institution sending the statement.

SenderIndividualContact.name: Sender Individual Contact
SenderIndividualContact.definition: Specifies the individual to contact in case of technical problems at the sender's location.

Receiver.name: Receiver
Receiver.definition: Financial institution customer receiving the statement.

ReceiverIndividualContact.name: Receiver Individual Contact
ReceiverIndividualContact.definition: Specifies the individual to contact in case of technical problems at the receiver's location.

BillingStatement.name: Billing Statement
BillingStatement.definition: Provides the bank services billing statement recounting of all service chargeable events that occurred during a reporting cycle, such as the end of the month reporting.
